subject.title: Hosted Molty (usemolty.com): model selector doesn't persist — API always receives dotted id claude-opus-4.8[Błąd]:

question: Should this be handled first as hosted Molty deployment/state triage, or as a source-owned OpenClaw UI/gateway normalization bug for full dotted Anthropic ids?
rationale: Current main's normal picker/session patch path uses catalog ids, but the reported failure is on hosted usemolty.com and may involve a separate Brain & Keys layer or stale hosted state outside this repository.

options.title: Verify hosted Molty payload first
options.body: Inspect the deployed Brain & Keys save/request payload and stored workspace model state, then migrate or redeploy if hosted code is sending display-derived dotted ids.

options.title: Queue a narrow source fix after proof
options.body: If hosted Molty uses this source path, add a focused regression that normalizes or rejects full dotted Anthropic ids before provider dispatch.

options.title: Route to hosted support
options.body: If the failing layer is outside OpenClaw source, keep this as hosted ops/support tracking and close only after recovery proof is available.

recommendation.title: Verify hosted Molty payload first
recommendation.body: Inspect the deployed Brain & Keys save/request payload and stored workspace model state, then migrate or redeploy if hosted code is sending display-derived dotted ids.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue crosses Anthropic model ids and session model persistence, both areas with recent merged history from this owner signal.
